summary_1line: Yudhishthira defends faith in virtue and divine order; Draupadi replies that action, effort, and intelligent striving—along with fate—are essential for success.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi, distressed yet resolute, speaks passionately to Yudhishthira in the forest exile while the Pandava brothers listen around her.
A symbolic farmer ploughs and sows seeds while dark clouds gather above, illustrating Draupadi’s analogy of effort awaiting rain.
Ascetic rishis glowing with spiritual power stand in a forest hermitage, portrayed as capable of blessing or cursing even the gods.
